title: Chest Radiograph
hints: A chest radiograph is a projection image: findings are described by zone (upper/mid/lower), side, and silhouette, not by segment.
Absence of a finding in the report is NOT a denial. Only label `denied` when the report explicitly negates it.
Technical-quality statements (rotation, projection, inspiration, exposure) are real, reportable findings here — label them, do not treat them as commentary.
Support devices and post-surgical changes are reportable findings; label them when stated.
Paediatric studies use the same vocabulary as adult studies.
